about_the_game:
Set in a dystopian world, destroyed by greed, the last of their kind gather around the rumored island. This island is protected by a mysterious force. Only pure souls cleansed of greed may enter. Are you worthy to step foot on the Sanctuary of Giving?

GAMEPLAY

The game is all about giving. You may give a piece of yourself to plant it in soil. After you harvest your plant, you will then have the option to give it to someone else. As other players and wildlife do the same, they might also give something to you. 

MULTIPLAYER

The island is a multiplayer area and you may encounter other players that may accept your acts of generosity, or vice versa. We strongly recommend you invite your friends to join so you may share the joys of generosity together. An internet connection is not required to play as you can still complete the game offline by interacting with the wildlife instead of players. 

THEME

This game is designed for the 3-week TGC x COREBLAZER game jam and their given theme “generosity”. We used this project as an opportunity to explore the delicate balance between self-sacrifice, self-care, greed and generosity. During gameplay you will have to manage your own well-being, as well as spread the joys of generosity with other players and wildlife. Both visual and audio elements dynamically change to make the player feel the state of their character’s journey.
